'''Kirlocca's funeral''' was a [[Funeral/Legends|remembrance ceremony]] that was held in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]<ref name="Force Convergence" /> in around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]<ref name="21 BBY" /> to celebrate the life of [[Kirlocca]], a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who was [[Death/Legends|killed]] while confronting the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Raik Muun]]. Various senior dignitaries from across the [[Star system/Legends|system]] attended the event and several non-lethal combat competitions were staged during the proceedings to honor Kirlocca's excellence in life as a combat instructor.<ref name="Force Convergence" />
